catalog_only: Every physical warehouse table and metadata-readiness table; individual genes, raw hits, matrices and unresolved measurements stay in source files.
unresolved_join_policy: Preserve status and evidence pointer; never mint exact sample-to-flux or physical-sample identity.
embedding_policy: Catalog availability and protocol only; no cross-run nearest-neighbor edges without validated extraction compatibility.
source_coverage_policy: All registered release rows; out-of-release attempts quarantined with provenance and explicit reason.
external_reuse_policy: Unknown source licensing denies external export. Local owner-driven internal review only.
